name: nitric acid
rationale: one connectivity; no isomer of HNO3 exists as a stable neutral

name: nitrous acid
rationale: HONO cis/trans are conformers of one structure; the nitro form is not a stable gas-phase neutral

name: peroxynitric acid
rationale: HOONO2 is the only stable connectivity

name: methanesulfonic acid
rationale: CH3SO3H is the only acid of this formula; methyl sulfite is not a stable gas-phase neutral

name: iodous acid
rationale: HOIO is the only stable connectivity

name: iodine dioxide radical (OIO)
rationale: OIO; the IOO peroxy isomer is not a stable atmospheric species

name: iodine nitrite
rationale: the IONO / INO2 pair is one reservoir species in the CIMS reading

name: iodine nitrate
rationale: IONO2 is the only stable connectivity

name: iodine cyanide (ICN)
rationale: ICN; the isocyanide INC is not observed as a neutral

name: iodine isocyanate (INCO)
rationale: INCO is the connectivity the family names

name: nitrophenol
rationale: 2-, 3- and 4-nitrophenol share the formula; mass cannot separate them

name: dinitrocresol
rationale: dinitro-methylphenol positional isomers; 4,6-dinitro-o-cresol is one of many

name: trifluoroacetic acid
rationale: CF3COOH is the only structure, but the pass-0 perfluoroacid family asserts the CLASS (a generated CnHF(2n-1)O2 list), not the compound: one structure is no identification here (read only by the merge vote's private class, docs/EVIDENCE_LEVELS.md section 13)

name: perfluoropropanoic acid
rationale: CF3CF2COOH only; the same class-scope note as TFA

name: perfluorooctanoic acid
rationale: linear and branched perfluoro chains; technical PFOA is a branched mixture

name: hexamethylcyclotrisiloxane (D3)
rationale: the cyclic trimer is the only structure the family admits for this formula

name: 2-methylbenzothiazole
rationale: the methyl can sit on C2 or the benzo ring

name: 2(3H)-benzothiazolone
rationale: benzothiazolone and 2-hydroxybenzothiazole tautomer count as one; benzoxazole-thiol is the other

name: dithiocarbamate methyl ester
rationale: methyl dimethyldithiocarbamate and its ester isomers

name: methylthiazole
rationale: methyl positions on thiazole and isothiazole

name: tetramethylthiourea
rationale: tetramethyl- and other tetra-alkyl thiourea isomers

name: ethanol via hydride abstraction
rationale: the pinned neutral is ethanol; the profile admits one origin for this ion

name: triethyl phosphate (TEP)
rationale: triethyl phosphate, dipropyl hydrogen phosphate and mixed esters share the formula

name: tributyl phosphate (TBP / TiBP)
rationale: n-, iso-, sec- and tert-butyl esters and mixed esters

name: triphenyl phosphate (TPhP)
rationale: triphenyl phosphate and the phenyl-phenylene phosphonate isomers

name: tricresyl phosphate
rationale: o/m/p-cresyl mixed esters (technical TCP is a mixture)

name: malathion
rationale: malathion, isomalathion and the O,S-dimethyl / diethyl ester isomers
